$description: Rātā design tokens — machine-readable companion to specifications/design-tokens.md. The markdown file is the source of truth (see DT-1 in that file); if this file and the markdown ever disagree, the markdown wins and this file should be regenerated from it, not edited independently. Structured using W3C Design Tokens Community Group conventions ($value/$type/$description, https://design-tokens.github.io/community-group/format/) as a pragmatic, machine-parseable format — not a claim of strict spec validation. Some documented categories (decorative palette, deprecated colours) are intentionally omitted below because specific values are not yet captured in the markdown source; see the corresponding $description notes and specifications/design-tokens.md for status. Mobile (Android/iOS, KMP/Material 3) token values are not yet confirmed against this file — see 'Platform status' in specifications/design-tokens.md.

decorative.$description: Chart/tag/accent palette — blue, green, orange, purple, red, teal, yellow, each with default/dark/light variants. Specific hex values are not yet captured in specifications/design-tokens.md; do not fabricate values here. Extract from eroadTheme.ts colors.ts (eroad/myeroad-portal) when confirming this section, then add tokens here and in the markdown together.

deprecated.$description: deprecatedSurfaceCriticalRed and deprecatedRagAmberText MUST NOT be used in new work — both fail the contrast requirements in accessibility.md (A11Y-3) against their non-deprecated surfaces (see DT-3). Specific hex values are not yet captured in specifications/design-tokens.md.

typography.$description: Sizes MUST use relative units (rem) on web so they scale with the browser's text-size setting — required by accessibility.md A11Y-4.

spacing.$description: Base unit 4px. spacing(n) = n × 4px. Any spacing value MUST be expressible as spacing(n) for some whole or half n — arbitrary values (e.g. 13px) MUST NOT be used.

borderRadius.$description: Square corners is the deliberate current Rātā default across components, not an unstyled default. Do not change without a design system change request (DT-4).

breakpoint.$description: Mobile device size classes are the platform-specific equivalent — see platforms.md.

inputSize.$description: Applies to inputs, selects, buttons, and similar controls. All interactive touch targets MUST still meet the minimum target size in accessibility.md (A11Y-5, 44×44px) — pad hit areas where a visual size below is used for a touch-operated control.

elevation.$description: Stacking order, ascending — a higher value MUST render above a lower one.
